reasons.1: Clean illustrated material planes and restrained texture fit F04, though the face, curls and leather are more smoothly polished than the anchor figure.

reasons.5: Painted cloth, leather and brass belong to the anchor family without conspicuous grain, but the finer, smoother hair and facial modeling differ from F04's broader painted treatment.
